title: Seat `ia preview` and `ia author` at target-owning `@workspace`, add `@mandate` `authority.words` allow-lists, and isolate pathological `.ia` sources
summary: Seat `ia preview` and `ia author` at the `@workspace` owning the target path via longest-root resolution (#285); add optional `authority.words` allow-lists on `@schema mandate` with enforcement across runtime, CLI, `steward-hook` and `ia validate` (`COMP-MANDATE` / `IA-COMP-MANDATE-WORD`, #286); and replace unbounded spread/recursion and quadratic diagnostic paths in `@inventarch/language` and `@inventarch/db` so oversized or malformed `.ia` sources fail cleanly without call-stack overflow or heap exhaustion (#198).
